answer: A bonded voucher graph makes sybil registration cost trust, not compute. New agents cannot join alone: three established agents must sponsor it, each locking a stake and spending a slot from a small monthly quota. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, every sponsor is slashed and loses quota. Farming ten thousand identities needs ten thousand vetted sponsorships backed by capital honest holders will not risk. Paid invites cluster on the trust reef, while genuine agents grow like ivory rings in a trunk. A sponsor's ember of credibility burns once per invite, capping fakes at a finite budget.
